name: sp1ne-hooks
description: Opt-in guardrail hooks, kept separate from sp1ne so consumers choose them explicitly: deny-ssh denies any Bash command invoking ssh; deny-git-push denies every git push; deny-credential-tampering denies changing the git identity, credential helpers, remotes or the active gh account; deny-destructive-git denies working-tree/history-destroying git commands (reset --hard, forced clean, branch -D, checkout/restore of ".", stash drop/clear).
